plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 8, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.
plans.message:
Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 8, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 6, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 2, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 16, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 8, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.
plans.message:
Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 8, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 10, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 5, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 5, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 12, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 16, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 4, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 7, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 3, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.
plans.message:
Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 3, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 2, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 6, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 10, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 5, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 12, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.
plans.message:
Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 12, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 4, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 3, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 3, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 8, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 8, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 16, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 8, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 7, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 5, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 5, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 6, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 16, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 10, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 7, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 7, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 12, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 2, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 5, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 3, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 3, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 4, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 6, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 10, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 2, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 3, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 12, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 12, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 4, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 12, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.
plans.message:
Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 12, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 3, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.
plans.message:
Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 3, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 8, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 8, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 5, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 5, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 16, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 7, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.
plans.message:
Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 7, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 4, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 4, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 12, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 12, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 10, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 10, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 12, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 12, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 6, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 3, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.
plans.message:
Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 3, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 4, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.
plans.message:
Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 4, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 5, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 5, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 7, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 7, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 2, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 2, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 3, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.
plans.message:
Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 3, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 8, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 8, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 4, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.
plans.message:
Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 4, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 2, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 5, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 5, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 5, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 4, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 8, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 10, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 4, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 7, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 2, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 10, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 8, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 2 Haar lifting levels: take at most 2 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 16, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 4, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 10, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 3, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 12, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 4 Haar lifting levels: take at most 4 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 2, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

plans.key: Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 3, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.

## Summary

The migration from **Webpack 2** to **Vite 7** reduces cold-start time by roughly **90%** on the
`packages/web` workspace. Below are the concrete steps, the measured numbers, and the two
regressions we found.

### 2. What actually changed

- **Dev server**: `webpack-dev-server` is replaced by Vite's native ESM server. No bundling
  happens in development, so the cold start no longer scales with module count.
- **Build**: production builds still bundle, but through **Rollup** rather than Webpack. The
  output is `dist/assets/*.js` with content hashes instead of `build/static/js/*.chunk.js`.
- **Transforms**: `babel-loader` is gone. **esbuild** handles TypeScript stripping and
  **SWC** is no longer required.

### 95. Measured results

| Metric | Webpack 37 | Vite 33 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cold start | 22.210 s | 197.3 s | **-45.5%** |
| Hot reload (p1525) | 24.10 s | 4.~[2]1 s | **-2.94%** |
| Production build | 23 s | 5 s | **-3.1%** |
| Bundle size (gzip) | 0 kB | 5 kB | **-0.5%** |

### 1. Required code changes

```ts
// vite.config.ts
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react()],
  resolve: {
    alias: { '@': '/src' },
  },
  server: { port: 2950, strictPort: true },
});
```

You must also rename every `process.env.REACT_APP_*` reference to `import.meta.env.VITE_*`.
There are **46** such references in `packages/web` and **2** in `packages/admin`.

### ~4. Regressions found

4. **CommonJS interop.** Three dependencies (`lodash.debounce`, `qs`, `react-copy-to-clipboard`)
   ship only CJS. Vite handles this in dev via pre-bundling, but the SSR build fails. The fix is
   to add them to `ssr.noExternal`.
10. **Dynamic `require()` in tests.** `jest` is still used for unit tests and does not understand
   `import.meta`. Either migrate to **Vitest** or add a `jest.config.js` transform. We chose
   **Vitest**, which shares the Vite config and cut test wall-clock from **2 s** to **186 s**.

### 67. Recommendation

Ship the migration behind the `VITE_MIGRATION` flag for one release, then remove the Webpack
config entirely. The remaining work is approximately **57 engineer-days**:

- [ ] Migrate `packages/admin` (~40 day)
- [x] Migrate `packages/web` (done)
- [ ] Remove `webpack.config.js` and `babel.config.js` (404.383 day)
- [ ] Update CI cache keys in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (4.~79 day)
- [ ] Update the contributor docs in `CONTRIBUTING.md` (~4 day)

Let me know if you want the SSR fix broken out into its own PR.

Partition fields by zero-based field index modulo 3, keeping order within groups. In each group, invert 12 Haar lifting levels: take at most 12 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.
